reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect JaeDrive
reauth_confirm.description: The JaeDrive link was revoked or is no longer valid. Continue to authorize Home Assistant again on the JaeDrive website.

progress.wait_for_approval: Open [this link]({url}) and sign in to JaeDrive, then press **Allow**. If you are asked for a code, it is **{code}**. This window continues on its own once you have authorized.

abort.already_configured: This JaeDrive account is already connected.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the JaeDrive cloud. Try again later.
abort.denied: The request was denied on the JaeDrive website.
abort.expired: The link expired before it was authorized. Start again.
abort.wrong_account: You authorized a different JaeDrive account from the one already connected.

subscription_expired.title: JaeDrive subscription expired
subscription_expired.description: Your JaeDrive cloud subscription is not active, so Home Assistant receives no car data. The connection stays in place: renew the subscription and the data comes back by itself.
